title: Study in Patients With COPD
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine which dose of the investigational drug is the most safe and effective compared to the control drug.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

-History of COPD and cigarette smoking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of asthma.
* Chest X-ray that is diagnostic of a significant pulmonary disease other than COPD
* Disease of other major organ systems
